## Project direction

This project focuses on preparing multiple waves of Nigeria’s General Household Survey Panel for analysis of household welfare, agriculture, health, education, and digital inclusion.

## Planned analytical workflow

1. Inventory files and modules by wave.
2. Identify household, individual, plot, and community keys.
3. Check duplicates, missingness, and identifier integrity.
4. Map variables across waves and assess conceptual comparability.
5. Document units, reference periods, and population definitions.
6. Build validated analysis-ready tables.

## Publication status

This page outlines a project direction. Final harmonised data, validation results, and code are not yet published here.
